id: Somatic Breathwork Journey-Mangaroa Farm, 98 Whitemans Valley Road, Te Awa Kairangi, Upper Hutt-Mangaroa
name: Somatic Breathwork Journey
venue: Mangaroa Farm, 98 Whitemans Valley Road, Te Awa Kairangi, Upper Hutt
long_description:
Join Amy Webber and Mangaroa Farms for a journey into your breath.

Somatic Breathwork™ is a full embodiment experience designed to help you release stress, trauma, emotions and stuck energy from the body. This is a modality that utilizes your own breath to help shed the layers of yourself that no longer serve, making room for you to call in what will help facilitate change within your life.

Somatic Breathwork™ uses a consciously connected breath pattern to help you tap into your body's innate inner intelligence and find the areas that need clearing. Coupling the breath with immersive music may result in different forms of cathartic emotional releases such as laughing, moving, crying, yelling, and shaking. All forms of expression are encouraged as it allows the body to move any pent up energy and create space for the second half of the breathwork journey.

A gentler breathing technique is used in the second half of the session to help you connect with who you truly are. Together we can use the breath to call in how you want to show up in the world, the changes you want to make, and allow you to see clearly what it would be like to live your best life.

Join Amy Webber and Mangaroa Farms for this immersive journey into your mind and heart. Any questions, please email amy@mangaroa.org

Continue your journey

Curious to explore more of Amy's work? Visit Lucid Living for her online and one-on-one sessions. You'll also find free guided recordings there, including a 15-minute breathwork journey and mini meditations, to enjoy at home in your own time. Check out here website here.

id: Permaculture Orchard Workshop – Growing Fruit with Nature-Mangaroa Farm, 98 Whitemans Valley Road, Te Awa Kairangi, Upper Hutt-Mangaroa
name: Permaculture Orchard Workshop – Growing Fruit with Nature
venue: Mangaroa Farm, 98 Whitemans Valley Road, Te Awa Kairangi, Upper Hutt
long_description:
Join Mangaroa Farms for Permaculture Orchard Workshop – Growing Fruit with Nature. Take a deeper dive into the workings of a permaculture orchard and discover how ecological principles can help us grow healthier, more productive fruit trees.

Through a mix of theory and hands-on practical learning, we'll explore ecological succession, plant guilds, soil health, biodiversity and the relationships that create resilient orchard ecosystems.

Learn practical techniques you can apply at any scale, from a single backyard fruit tree to a thriving food forest.

We will begin at Sat 7th November | 10:00am at 108 Whitemans Valley Road (Garden).

Any questions, please email events@mangaroa.org

id: Grass to Garden Workshop-Mangaroa Farm, 98 Whitemans Valley Road, Te Awa Kairangi, Upper Hutt-Mangaroa
name: Grass to Garden Workshop
venue: Mangaroa Farm, 98 Whitemans Valley Road, Te Awa Kairangi, Upper Hutt
long_description:
Join Mangaroa Farms for a hands-on Grass to Garden Workshop where we'll explore the practical skills and ideas you need to transform your patch of lawn or pasture into a thriving, productive garden space.

Through a mix of kōrero and hands-on learning, we'll dive into different approaches to garden establishment — from no-dig methods and sheet mulching to cultivation and soil preparation. You'll discover how to build healthy soil, manage weeds, make good use of organic materials, and create fertile growing spaces that work with nature.

Learn accessible, low-cost techniques you can take home and apply straight away, whether you're starting your first vegetable bed or expanding what you've already got going.

We will begin at Thu 12th November | 4:00pm at 108 Whitemans Valley Road (Garden).

Any questions, please email events@mangaroa.org
